name: agent-video-desk
description: Shared browser desks for an AI agent (Claude Code, Codex) and a human: co-edit a video script, pick footage by transcript words, and transcribe Russian speech verbatim with word timestamps.

interface.shortDescription: Co-edit scripts and pick footage with your agent
interface.longDescription: Script Desk: leave notes on a video script in the browser, press Fix, and your agent proposes edits you take or skip; every accepted round becomes a version snapshot. Footage Desk: watch clips next to their word-level transcript, mark takes and skips, and let the agent pick the rest and build the cut list. ru-transcribe: verbatim Russian speech-to-text with word timestamps (GigaAM + WhisperX).
defaultPrompt: Open Script Desk for the script in this folder
Build Footage Desk from the clips in this folder
Transcribe this Russian recording with word timestamps
